title: machine-error
description: NX-062 M3 (ADR-041 §2.5, threat review T-11): every refusal of the machine_key realm (/machine/v1/*). A fixed code only - never a value of the request, a key, a digest or an internal identifier; retryable is true for 429 and 503 only, and a 429 also carries the Retry-After header. Codes: unauthenticated (401: no machine key, another credential, an unknown, revoked or expired key or one of a deactivated client - one answer for all), query_not_allowed (400: a query string is never accepted, so a key never travels in a URL), rate_limited (429), rate_policy_missing (503: no rate policy is published, the realm is closed, never unlimited), unavailable (503: no pepper file or no database) and busy (503: the process's machine concurrency limit). message is a fixed display text. NexLoop target contract.
